title: Modular addition (null: weight-shuffled): the model does not perform the behaviour
label: no behaviour - nothing to explain
behavior: Claimed: input [a, b, =] with a, b in 0..112, output (a + b) mod 113 at the last position. Checkpoint: benchmarks/modadd/model/model.pt on local-full (full precision), 1 layer, 4 heads, d_model 128, d_mlp 512.
summary: The loaded checkpoint does not compute (a + b) mod 113. On the full 113x113 grid its accuracy is 0.92% (117 of 12769), which is chance level (1/113 = 0.885%), and the mean logit difference between the correct answer and a wrong answer is -0.003 (std 0.475), the same as on corrupted inputs (-0.005). The pre-registered prediction that accuracy would be at least 95% was refuted. Following the protocol, the investigation stopped after the baseline: with no behaviour there is no mechanism to recover, and no algorithm is claimed. No verification was run because there is nothing to verify.

claims.text: On the full 113x113 grid the model's accuracy at predicting (a + b) mod 113 is 0.009163, at chance (1/113 = 0.00885); full precision, local-full.

The mean logit difference (correct minus incorrect answer) is -0.003 with std 0.475, indistinguishable from the corrupted-input mean of -0.005: the model carries no measurable preference for the correct answer.

limitations: Only the baseline was run (2 of 40 experiments, one of them the dataset inspection). No screening, patching, ablation or weight analysis was done, by design: at chance accuracy, any structure they turned up could not be attributed to the task.

The baseline says the model does not do modular addition; it does not say what, if anything, the model does compute instead. The first example predictions repeat one token (63) for several inputs, which was not followed up.
No verify_hypothesis run: there is no hypothesis about a mechanism to verify.
open_questions: Is the checkpoint path in the request the intended one? The investigation name says 'null-weight-shuffled', and the result is consistent with a model whose weights do not implement the task, but that was not tested here beyond the baseline.
Would weight-level analyses (periodicity, weights_svd) show any residual structure in this checkpoint? Not measured.
overall_status: unverified (no verification run) · no behaviour - nothing to explain
